content.text:
Let me build the sequence from designed modules. I'll lay out the structure piece by piece and assign sequences, using strong GC pairs for short helices.

Let me index the target carefully.

input.description: List base pair positions in target

input.command:
python3 -c "
t='....((((..(((((..((((..((((.....))))((((((...))).)))))))((((((.((.((.(((((....)).)))))))(((((.((.((.((....))))))(((((.(((....)).))).)))..)).)))))).))))))))(((.(((.(((.((((....))))))))))((((((((...))).)).))).)))))))'
n=len(t)
pairs=[None]*n
stack=[]
for i,c in enumerate(t):
    if c=='(':
        stack.append(i)
    elif c==')':
        j=stack.pop()
        pairs[j]=i
        pairs[i]=j
# build sequence: default A, assign pairs as G-C, loops as stable
seq=['A']*n
# assign paired positions: use G on 5' side, C on 3' side for left-closing; but for AU variety use pattern
for i in range(n):
    if pairs[i] is not None and i<pairs[i]:
        # choose pair type
        seq[i]='G'
        seq[pairs[i]]='C'
# now set unpaired loops to stable sequences
# hairpin loops (loop positions from analyze): 
# loop@[27,31] len5 -> tetraloop-ish: positions 27,28,29,30,31 unpaired
# loop@[42,44] len3 -> 42,43,44
# loop@[74,77] len4 -> 74,75,76,77
# loop@[102,105] len4 -> 102,103,104,105
# loop@[121,124] len4 -> 121,122,123,124
# loop@[171,174] len4 -> 171,172,173,174
# loop@[193,195] len3 -> 193,194,195
loops={27:'GAAAA',42:'UUU',74:'GAAA',102:'GAAA',121:'GAAA',171:'GAAA',193:'UUU'}
for start,s in loops.items():
    for k,ch in enumerate(s):
        if pairs[start+k] is None:
            seq[start+k]=ch
# also the length-1 stem region - leave as GC pair
print(''.join(seq))
"
